text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-ah...!
That was so delicious this time too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Pot-au-feu, ramen, pizza,
mapo tofu, and ice cream for dessert...
Every single bit of it was deeply satisfying!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Actually, I tweaked it a bit this time
to boost its recovery effects.
Especially after doing all that fieldwork.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not bad.
Guess your past experience really paid off, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. What happened with Bourbon-san and Spe-san
was quite the learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The power that cooking holds, the relationship we have with food...
I feel like I'm gradually starting to understand.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Moving forward, it's nothing but
trial and buono for us!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Gotta do my best with both growing veggies and cooking 'em. Now that I've eaten, time to get back to work!
